name: Panel / Admin Sidebar
description: Admin Sidebar product scenario for the Panel component.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Rows in order, groups nesting their rows; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Value of the current page's row, marked `aria-current="page"`; `null` marks none, and an unknown value marks none.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Current row on mount when `value` is not set; read once.

controls.name: expanded
controls.description: Values of the groups showing their rows; unknown values are kept but show nothing.

controls.name: defaultExpanded
controls.description: Expanded groups on mount when `expanded` is not set; read once. Default: the groups that hold the current row.

controls.name: collapsed
controls.description: Whether the inline panel is a rail of icons, labels kept as accessible names; a sheet never collapses.

controls.name: defaultCollapsed
controls.description: Whether the panel is collapsed on mount when `collapsed` is not set; read once.

controls.name: collapsible
controls.description: Shows the button that collapses the panel to a rail, and lets a group in the rail open the panel at it; false leaves `collapsed` to the parent, and groups then open in the rail. Default true.

controls.name: width
controls.description: Width of the expanded inline panel: a number or numeric string is pixels, or pass a CSS length. Wins over `style.width`; otherwise that style is used, then 260px.

controls.name: collapsedWidth
controls.description: Width of the collapsed rail: a number or numeric string is pixels, or pass a CSS length. Wins over `style.width`; default 60px.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: `inline` shows the panel; `sheet` shows a trigger that opens the rows in a drawer at the start edge; `auto` is a sheet below 900px.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Whether the sheet is open; only a sheet surface opens, and leaving it closes an uncontrolled sheet.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Whether the sheet is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: trigger
controls.description: Element that opens the sheet, keeping its own props; text renders as a Button. Default: an icon button named `labels.open`.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the navigation landmark (default "Sidebar") and titles the sheet.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Panel renders itself: `open` names the default sheet trigger, `close` the sheet's close button, `expand` and `collapse` the rail toggle.
